overview.description: The Defiance US 100 Tech Ex Software ETF (XIGV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund tracks an index of US technology companies that excludes software-focused businesses. The fund provides exposure to large US technology companies outside the software industry. XIGV was launched on Jun 24, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
